summary: Full-extraction pass over 20 stored Cyprus documents: Audit Office reports of Sept 2020, Nov 2020 and Aug 2022, the Nicolatos inquiry report (2021), Laws 36(I)/2013 and 113(I)/2020, Regulations ΚΔΠ 379/2020, residence-scheme criteria (2023), and Interior Ministry, Law Office and European Commission releases. Main additions: naturalisations by year and applicant type 2008-2020, programme subtotals, low-/high-risk statistics, compliance shares, deprivation decisions and recommendations, revenue-loss and VAT tables, property-contract monitoring tables, and criteria not yet recorded. Nationality splits exist but country names are blacked out in the published inquiry report.
